## EHH plot

```{r}
library(rehh)
require("argparse")

parser <- ArgumentParser()
#parser$add_argument("-c", "--chr", help = "p")
#parser$add_argument("-p", "--pos", help = "point")
parser$add_argument("-mk", "--marker", help = "marker")
args <- parser$parse_args()

#chrom <- args$chr
mk <- args$marker
mk
#chrom <- "chr2"
#p <- 212672068
#mk <- paste(chrom, p, sep="_")
#mk <- ">18408685>18408682"

hh_vcf <- data2haplohh(hap_file = "ehh.vcf.gz",
                       vcf_reader = "data.table",
                       verbose = FALSE,
                       min_perc_geno.mrk=95,
                       polarize_vcf = FALSE)
#hh_vcf                       
#plot(hh_vcf)

#print(res)
plot(res)
```
